newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sabena says H1 traffic rose 29 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sabena says H1 traffic rose 29 pct.

text.p: Belgian airline Sabena SA, which is 49 percent owned by Switzerland's Swissair Group, said on Tuesday it carried 3,075,237 passengers in the first half of 1997, up 29 percent on 1996.

European passenger traffic rose 32 percent, routes to Africa and North America were each up around 17 percent while traffic to Japan fell 14 percent. Demand for economy class places was up 41 percent, business class traffic rose one percent.
"Sabena is on the right road to meet the objective fixed by its shareholders, that is to say the strict adherence to its budgetary objectives at the end of June 1997," the company said.
